cards.card_text: Next on the order: cedar, cypress and algum logs from Lebanon, since Hiram's servants know how to cut timber there.
cards.verse_text: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there.

cards.card_text: The servants of Hiram, king of Tyre (2 Chronicles 2:3), and Solomon's servants, the ones who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum wood and precious stones.
cards.verse_text: (The servants of Hiram and of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir also brought algum wood and precious stones.
